text: An integrated approach is recommended rather than chemicals alone: crop rotation, using plastic mulch to suppress weed hosts, hand-removal of low pest numbers, and — specifically for fruit flies — pheromone (kairomone) traps: a simple version is made by pouring diluted honey/rice-wine or mashed ripe fruit into a small container inside a hanging funnel/bottle trap set at roughly 70-80cm above the ground, refreshed periodically, to draw in and drown fruit flies before they lay eggs in the crop.
